Steering Committee members suggested that the Agency either reduce some project area investments and/or seek alternative funding sources, thereby reducing the need for Block Grant money.
Backesto Park
John Guisto explained Parks and Recreation's proposal for $200,000 for Backesto Park. Use of money to be determined by planning process involving citizens. Other projects proposed for Backesto could be considered in that process.
Discussion - Northside has two large community centers. Don't feel need for another at Backesto Park. Discussion of sidewalks.
Other two issues- Sr. Rec. Room - $26,400 - not enough to build $33,000 for field house - quality of existing building doesn't warrant renovation. 600 square feet for Sr. Center. Northside Center nearby to accommodate.
